headline.text: Trump launches a Super Intelligence Force, led by his spy chief

slides.altText: Trump launches a Super Intelligence Force, led by his spy chief

body.text: Trump announced the force in a Sunday morning post on Truth Social.
The Wall Street Journal reports Clayton will chair the force, with three vice chairs.

slides.altText: His pitch: "The Super Intelligence Force is tasked with coordinating the effort of the Federal Government … of all Americans," (Donald Trump)

body.text: The charter reportedly says it will plan responses to SI-enabled threats while preventing overregulation.
